bias.en: Bearish · lower highs above the Sep 3 low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 高点下移，守在 9 月 3 日低点上方

read.en: ASML fell 1.0% on Oct 20 to $1,630.84 on light volume, trading between $1,613.54 and $1,654.19. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,645.4), 10-day ($1,705.0) and 30-day ($1,723.4) averages and the rising 100-day ($1,749.4), and above the rising 200-day ($1,582.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,815.63), and RSI is 36.9.

The high slipped to $1,654, and the low briefly undercut the $1,619 Sep 3 low before the close recovered above it. Resistance is $1,645–1,654 (5-day average, Oct 20 high), then $1,682–1,686 (Oct 13 low, Oct 16 high) and $1,705–1,723. Support is $1,619, then $1,594 (Oct 15 low) and $1,573–1,582 (Sep 14 low, 200-day). A close below $1,594 would open $1,573.
